unrecoverable: Saved browser reports contain player positions and per-step actor-match booleans, not complete actor arrays or a video. They are displayed as reports, not fabricated animated replays.
Uninstrumented reads, overwritten transient drafts, model-internal processing and complete per-stage time/token attribution cannot be recovered from these files.
The observer has no direct SKILL.md read event; recovered client read requests are shown separately from verified resource deliveries.

client.scope: Launch-to-exit tool records only. Messages, internal reasoning, raw command arguments and output bodies are excluded. Round-trip time includes tool transport and waiting; it is not model thinking time.
